subject.statement: Do Kwon was sentenced to 15 years in prison in the United States in December 2025.

summary: As of my knowledge cutoff in mid‑2024, Do Kwon had not been sentenced in the United States; he was facing extradition from Montenegro and no credible reports existed of a 15‑year prison sentence imposed in December 2025.
